trials.claim: Deal does not include features or limits exclusive to higher or new plans
trials.claimQuote: This does not include features or limits exclusive to higher or new plans.
trials.reasoning: The vendor describes full branding control and unlimited features as Pro-plan benefits, and a buyer says the deal is a separate limited AppSumo plan, supporting that higher-plan exclusives are not included.

exhibits.quote: If you’re scaling fast and want full branding control, unlimited features, and high-level growth support, the Pro plan is just a click away.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states full branding control and unlimited features belong to the Pro plan, showing higher-plan exclusives.

exhibits.quote: Not the same as their regular create plan. This is a limited plan called AppSumo
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the deal is a limited plan different from the regular Creator plan.

trials.claim: Purchase includes all future updates to the plan based on tier
trials.claimQuote: Includes all future updates to the or xxx plan — based on your tier.
trials.reasoning: Buyers report LTD holders were moved from a full Creator plan to a basic plan and that a long-promised feature may not be included for LTD buyers, conflicting with all future updates being included.

exhibits.quote: The original plan was a creator plan including all features—email marketing, community, and basic white-label—but they suddenly changed everything, leaving us with a basic plan that is worthless.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports future features were removed from LTD buyers rather than included as updates.

exhibits.quote: Memberships have been "coming soon" for about a year now (I was told so myself by an agent on a live Support chat last year, and even that's in hope that this feature gets included for LTD).
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports long-promised new feature may never be included for LTD buyers.

trials.claim: Flowlance provides a digital storefront to sell products and services without coding or plugins
trials.claimQuote: Launch a digital storefront to sell products & services—no coding or plugins required
trials.reasoning: The vendor says Flowlance sells digital products and services without a website or tech skills, and a buyer confirms it works for selling; reports of downtime or one-page limits do not negate that core storefront exists.

exhibits.quote: Last month my shop was down right as I launched a product.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports storefront was unavailable when needed for selling.

exhibits.quote: However, its "one-pager" constraint is a major trade-off. It lacks the capacity to build out deep site architecture—like dedicated "About" or "Portfolio" or "Product (w categories)" pages—natively.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports storefront is limited to one page without real site architecture.

exhibits.quote: Flowlance helps you sell digital products and services without needing a website, tech skills, or a huge audience.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states Flowlance sells digital products and services without needing website or tech skills.

exhibits.quote: Flowlance is a great way to sell products and services.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms Flowlance works to sell products and services.

trials.claim: Flowlance automatically generates a landing page for each product created
trials.claimQuote: Flowlance automatically generates a landing page for each product you create.
trials.reasoning: The vendor states Flowie automatically builds the product, sales page, price, and checkout in the store; one report of a course misdirecting does not materially undercut that the page-generation feature exists.

exhibits.quote: Now the course I've developed won't lead to my course, instead my customers are taken to the Flowlance Community.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports product did not lead to its own page but misdirected elsewhere.

exhibits.quote: So Flowie does all of it: the product, the sales page, the words, the price, the checkout, assembled live in your store.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states Flowie builds the product plus sales page and checkout automatically in the store.

trials.claim: Product checkout page serves as its landing page
trials.claimQuote: The checkout page of your product serves as this landing page.
trials.reasoning: The only exhibit says a course link took customers to the Community instead, but it does not mention a checkout page serving as a landing page, so it is too weak to confirm or contradict this specific claim.

exhibits.quote: Now the course I've developed won't lead to my course, instead my customers are taken to the Flowlance Community.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports product checkout did not serve as its landing page.
